prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Waiting screen info enhancements (wait_info) can be helpful, winning 3 tests (+5.0%, +5.7%, +4.1%), though 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Adding new screens (new_screen) can be helpful, winning 2 tests (+15.4%, +6.4%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.7%) and 2 showed no clear effect.
Reordering steps (reorder) showed no clear effect in 1 test and hurt performance in another (-3.8%).
Copy adjustments, layout changes, redesigns, hints, and notifications showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins (e.g., predicting +3.0% vs +15.4% measured for pet preview, and +4.0% vs +6.4% for sound selection).
Predictions were generally too high for changes that showed no clear effect or resulted in a loss (e.g., predicting +15.4% for the quiz screen which measured -7.7%).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -0.5% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +2.5% over 5 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -2.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -1.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +1.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: -3.8% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +0.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: +4.2% over 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +0.5% over 2 test(s)
- home, notification: -1.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +3.5% over 5 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +1.2% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +0.6% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.1% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 74.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.5%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 24.1%

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Trait & Personality Fine-Tuner Screen: Add a new screen before adoption certificate where users adjust activity level and sound feedback sliders for their pet. (why: Adoption step takes a long mean time of 1017s, and support emails report post-onboarding confusion regarding companion controls and behavior.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Tray & Dock Shortcut Setup Screen: Add a new screen at the end showing an animated guide on toggling pet visibility and controls from the system tray. (why: Finish drop-off is 35.2% with a mean duration of 5815s, and support received 3 emails about desktop pet visibility issues and 3 emails about control confusion.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Diagnostics & Audio Tip on Waiting: Add display diagnostic status checks and a sound test button to the waiting screen while pet assets generate. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s and mean 2336s, while 3 support tickets reported pets failing to appear on desktop or open.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Engine Ready Sound Alert: Enable an option on the waiting screen that plays an audio chime when background pet rendering completes. (why: Mean wait time is 2336s because users background the app while pet assets render; an audio alert brings them back promptly.)
4: [home, wait_info] Interactive Sound FX Test on Waiting Screen: Add an interactive sound effect board on the waiting screen allowing users to trigger companion barks and purrs while waiting. (why: Lessons show waiting screen info enhancements consistently win tests (+5.0%, +5.7%, +4.1%) during long wait periods.)
5: [finish, redesign] Interactive Desktop Command Spotlight: Redesign home_intro into a spotlight layout highlighting top interactive desktop commands. (why: Finish screen conversion is 64.8%, and support received 3 emails regarding companion controls and 4 about post-onboarding desktop misbehavior.)
